# LIS 467 repo instructions

## Git routine (I work on both a Mac and a Linux machine)
- Repo: https://github.com/kameroncole/lis467.git, branch `master`.
- At the start of every session, run `git pull`. If local files conflict with incoming ones, ask me before overwriting.
- At the end of work, commit and run `git push origin master` so I can pull on the other machine.
- Commit only the files for the current task. The repo often has unrelated local changes, so don't use `git add -A` unless I ask.

## Assignment 3: HTML5, CSS3, Responsive Design + JavaScript
- All work goes in `assignment3/`. I do the assignment myself. You only track progress, review, and help when I ask.
- Source: `assignment3/colek - Assignment #3 Instructions.docx` (due Day 1 of Week 10, 20% of grade, individual).
- Site: Museum of Science educator portal, based on the Assignment 2 information architecture and wireframes (see `final-project/` and `assignment3/`).
- Company name: Agentic Curriculum Designers, Inc. It is a Moodle submission field. Not required on the page, but I plan to put it in the footer (or About page).
- Keep the checklist below up to date: tick a box only after checking the actual files in `assignment3/`, and report which items are still open when asked.

### Checklist
- [ ] Tutorials completed for HTML5, CSS3 and responsive design/media queries (record which ones)
- [ ] Main page (`index.html`) based on the A2 IA and wireframes
- [ ] Subpage linked from the main page
- [ ] Semantic elements (header, footer, aside, article, section, nav, bold, italics)
- [ ] One external CSS file styling both pages
- [ ] Styling: colors, text, links, images, content blocks, positioning
- [ ] At least two columns
- [ ] Responsive: meta viewport tag and CSS3 media queries
- [ ] At least one image manipulation, with images resized at the source (not only via CSS width)
- [ ] At least one use of JavaScript in an external `.js` file
- [ ] HTML validated at validator.w3.org, errors fixed
- [ ] CSS validated at jigsaw.w3.org/css-validator, errors fixed
- [ ] Tested in Chrome or Firefox and on different devices
- [ ] Uploaded to Simmons web space (HTML, CSS, JS, images in folders)
- [ ] Moodle submission (Module 10): name, company name, URL, tutorials used, validation/CSS/responsive/JS success (1-2 sentences), JavaScript explanation, experience reflection
